tut_guide.name: Guide Elsbeth
tut_guide.examine: An island guide with a whistle, a clipboard and the patience of someone who has explained walking a thousand times.

tut_survival.name: Survivalist Marlow
tut_survival.examine: Survivalist Marlow. He can light a fire with two wet sticks and a strong opinion.

tut_farmer.name: Gardener Fen
tut_farmer.examine: Gardener Fen, the island's gardener. There is soil under every fingernail and a radish in every pocket.

tut_quest.name: Loremaster Ilse
tut_quest.examine: Loremaster Ilse keeps the island's book of stories, and knows how every one of them ends.

tut_mining.name: Prospector Dunn
tut_mining.examine: Prospector Dunn, who talks to rocks. The rocks, he says, talk back.

tut_combat.name: Sergeant Kade
tut_combat.examine: Sergeant Kade. Shouts like a drill sergeant, which he was, and smiles like a grandfather, which he is.

tut_banker.name: Banker Corin
tut_banker.examine: Banker Corin, who keeps the island's chest and has never lost so much as a button.

tut_wallet.name: Ledger-keeper Asha
tut_wallet.examine: Ledger-keeper Asha. She knows where every coin in the valley is, and whose it really is.

tut_shop.name: Trader Milo
tut_shop.examine: Trader Milo, who will sell you anything and buy almost everything back.

tut_chapel.name: Brother Aldo
tut_chapel.examine: Brother Aldo of the island chapel, calm as a still pond.

tut_ferryman.name: Ferryman Odo
tut_ferryman.examine: Ferryman Odo. He has rowed every new face in the valley to Ashvale, and remembers most of them.
